real_defects.issue: The 'Delivery lost money overall' finding compared summed float net-after-costs with 0 directly, so three break-even orders (10.10 subtotal, 0.30 commission, 9.80 packaging) summing to -5.3e-15 showed both 'No order lost money' and 'Delivery lost money overall ... Net after costs is $0.00'. Fixed: compared at the cent.

The promotions finding flagged an exact break-even as high ('$1.00 of profit per $1 spent ... the spend cost more than these orders earned') because the ratio was 0.9999999999999911. Fixed: promo carries profitBeforeSpend in dollars and the finding compares it with spend at the cent.
